sources.name: Open Food Facts API introduction
notes: The documentation lists v3 as current and recommended for new integrations, with v3.6 as the latest v3 sub-version.
Product database data is voluntarily contributed and is not guaranteed accurate, complete, or reliable.
Read operations require a custom User-Agent but no API key or login.

sources.name: Open Food Facts rate limits
notes: Product reads are documented at 15 requests per minute per IP address.
Search queries are documented at 10 requests per minute per IP address.
Open Food Facts asks clients needing more than a few hundred products to use CSV or JSONL exports instead of the live API.

sources.name: Open Food Facts search availability
notes: Structured filter-based search is available through API v2 at /api/v2/search.
Structured search is not available in API v3.
Full-text search is not available in the v2/v3 server-side APIs.

sources.name: Open Food Facts authentication guidance
notes: Clients should send a custom User-Agent in the form AppName/Version (ContactEmail).
Write operations require authentication and are out of scope for this read-only print.
The CLI exposes OPEN_FOOD_FACTS_USER_AGENT and OPEN_FOOD_FACTS_CONTACT_EMAIL for responsible request identity.

non_goals: bulk harvesting or local database sync
